description: This file defines the ParentExpression class, which represents a 'parent' node in Twig's abstract syntax tree used for template inheritance. It provides functionality for compiling PHP code to render or yield parent blocks within Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\ParentExpression
classes.description: A class representing a parent node in Twig's expression syntax, enabling template inheritance features such as rendering parent blocks or yielding from them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ParentExpression with a specific block name and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for rendering or yielding the parent block based on the 'output' attribute.
